$comment: Canonical design tokens. TypeScript and Dart cannot import each other, so each app mirrors this file: propshop-web/src/app/globals.css (@theme block) and propshop-app/lib/theme/tokens.dart. Run `node packages/shared/check-tokens.mjs` to verify. PALETTE HISTORY: the owner overrode brief Section 11 (navy + emerald, 'bank app not classifieds') on 2026-09-16 in favour of dubizzle.com.eg, then the same day asked for a mix of nawy.com and dubizzle and chose 'navy structure + red actions'. So NAVY (#1e4164, sampled from nawy.com) carries structure — header, headings, labels, footer — and RED (#e00000, sampled from dubizzle.com.eg) carries action and the commission promise. Red must never appear on a heading, navy never on a primary button; that split is what tells a buyer where to click. PALETTE 2026-10-11: owner chose 'Forest & Flame' inverted, minimal (Apple-like). brand = action = FOREST #0f3d2e (outlined buttons, links); navy = structure = INK #1d1d1f and soft greys (headings, chrome is white); accent = identity = RUST #c24418 (logo, selected tabs, sliders, Verified); danger = errors (red is no longer an action colour).

rules.$comment: Business constants that both clients display. The server is always the authority; these exist so the UI can explain a rule before the server enforces it.
